_about: Tour layout only: where each stop is and which species it shows. Species facts live in species.json and are never written here. x,y are in the coordinates of the base map ("map": PDF points of NYBG's Garden Map 2025, viewBox 0 0 846 576; north is to the left). verify=true means the spot is approximate and needs confirming with NYBG / Plant Tracker. The dashed route on the map is drawn from these stops in order: a straight line into each stop, or the SVG path commands in route_in when the path curves.

map.credit: Map: New York Botanical Garden, Garden Map 2025
